title: 天皇賞（春）の後に・立ちはだかる鬼姉

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The spring Tenno Sho comes to an end with a cascade of cheers.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Super Creek puts on an incredible race, leaving a strong impression on Tamamo Cross.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Despite losing, her intimidating aura shakes Tamamo Cross to her core.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Tamamo Cross witnesses Super Creek race with a seriousness she's never seen before…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She then realizes that Super Creek has finally found her own reason to run.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Oguri Cap awaits Super Creek at her next race, the autumn Tenno Sho.
